text: Each repository the dashboard shows has a view of its own, at @gitdek's request (#773), so a repository Invariant works in can be followed and reviewed without Invariant's own work in the way. A view has an address, `?repo=` with the repository's short name, or owner/name when two share it, which the page opens on and keeps as Show's choice changes, so back and forward move between views. Its decisions come from its own journal, read at its branch's head, with its own decisions tile, and Invariant's road and who builds what show only in Invariant's view and Everything. Another repository's commits still aren't read, only its branch's ref. Built by hand alongside ask3d's pilot.
